Tuesday, 10:00–11:00 AM
Lab B break room (coffee's on me)

Howdy folks,
Same time, same place. This week we've got a real fork in the road, so please don't skip.

- Quick round-robin on assay runs (Yara, Ulla): 10 min, tops
- Stability data came back funky on lot 7. Will and Dana, bring your plots. We need to DECIDE whether we re-run or move ahead to the scale-up batch. That decision can't wait another week.
- Esme and Delia: freezer space crunch. We need to hash out who gives up what.

Bring opinions, bring data, bring snacks if you're feeling generous. Everyone on Bonfire 2.0 needs to be in the room for the lot 7 call.

Sofia"},{"spec_id":"spec_0523","text":"Abernathy contract – value engineering brainstorm
Wednesday, April 3 · 1:00 – 1:45pm
Jobsite trailer + Google Meet link

Guests: Liam (organizer), Vikram Castellano, Paloma Ostrowski, Hana Sorensen, Oskar Zapata, Emeka Cho, Ivan Moreau

Hey all! The owner wants about 6% shaved off the Abernathy budget, so let's throw ideas at the wall. Rough plan:
- Recap of where the budget stands (I'll walk through the spreadsheet)
- Each trade lead shares a quick update on their scope
- Open floor: swaps on the facade panels, slab thickness, MEP routing

Vikram and Paloma, you two know the structure best, so come ready. Everyone else, just bring whatever's on your mind. Snacks provided 🙂

Join with Google Meet
meet.google.com/xxx-xxxx-xxx"},{"spec_id":"spec_0524","text":"Hi all, @Tariq Rinaldi @Bruno Lefebvre @Pilar Carvalho @Soren Gunawardena

So, since last time nobody was answering in thread (no problem, I understand everyone is very busy of course), I am thinking we should do a 30 min call to plan the kickoff meeting for Gingham migration. Just so we are all on same page before the real meeting, because last time we were not on same page and it was taking a lot of time after, as some of you maybe remember.

In this call we can decide who will be invited to the kickoff, which day is good, maybe also how long the kickoff should be, and who makes the slides. I know some people prefer to just write in Slack, but honestly the experience shows that writing in Slack is not really working for this group, no offense to anybody.

I put some slots in calendar for Thursday or Friday afternoon. Please kindly accept one of them, ideally before end of day today, so I don't need to chase again like the last two times. Bruno, I know you said you are full this week but maybe you can move something, it's only 30 minutes.

Also if someone thinks we don't need this, it's fine, but then please tell me who is organizing the kickoff, because it is not very clear to me who took this, so by default I guess it is me again 🙂

Thanks in advance for the quick replies!!
Andre"},{"spec_id":"spec_0525","text":"🤠 Kestrel rollout check-in: Cleo copy, Yasmin assets, Imani dates"}]}
